name: i2c_target
description: I2C target, write transactions to address 0x48: shifter0 samples SDA on SCL rises, the lane matches the address, ACKs each byte and streams it to SRAM. Pin 0 is SCL (uio5), pin 1 is SDA (uio6); both outputs are open drain.

word_notes.0-1: timer0 period, unused but must be valid
word_notes.4: outputs 0 and 1 enabled and open drain; pin 0 (SCL) and pin 1 (SDA) edges on rise
word_notes.53-55: timer1 and shifter1 settings, unused but must be valid
word_notes.63: frame word as in the I2C controller image
word_notes.68: pins 0 and 1 read their own pads
